I could not complete a reliable three-parameter fit, so I can give only an approximate Dq and no B or C.

**Dq:** Under the usual weak-field approximation, the lowest spin-allowed band is ν₁ = ⁴T₂g ← ⁴T₁g(F) = 10Dq. That gives Dq ≈ 7150 / 10 = 715 cm⁻¹. This is only approximate. The ⁴T₁g(F) ground state mixes with ⁴T₁g(P), so ν₁ is not exactly 10Dq, and the correction depends on B.

**B and C:** Determining them needs the full d⁷ quartet and doublet secular matrices (Tanabe–Sugano). The ⁴A₂g band (15 200) does not agree with the pure-Dq value of about 18Dq ≈ 12 900 cm⁻¹, which confirms the mixing matters. I could not reliably reconstruct those matrices from memory to fit all four bands simultaneously, so I am not giving numerical B or C. A proper fit would diagonalise the d⁷ matrices and least-squares fit Dq, B and C to the four band positions, with C/B expected near 4–5.
